    Create a .gitignore file with an opinionated list of ignores

    use_gitignore_usgs.Rd

    Uses .gitignore file from https://code.usgs.gov/water/IWAAs-trends/templates/standard-template-repository/. Specify project-specific exclusions with the additions argument, which are appended to the end of the .gitignore.

    use_gitignore_usgs(home = ".", additions = NULL)

    Arguments

    home

    chr, root directory of project. Defaults to current working directory

    additions

    chr vector, other files/directories to be added to .gitignore

    Examples

    tmp <- tempdir()
use_gitignore_usgs(home = tmp,
                   additions = c("excluded_file.R",
                                 "excluded_dir",
                                 "*excluded_pattern*"))
#> ℹ Using .gitignore from
#>   <https://code.usgs.gov/water/IWAAs-trends/templates/standard-template-repository/>

# here are the contents of the .gitignore:
cat(readLines(file.path(tmp,".gitignore")), sep = "\n")
